import numpy as np
import os

import cv2
import warnings

try:
    import tensorflow as tf
    from tensorflow.keras.preprocessing.image import load_img, img_to_array

        tf_tensor = SimpleModel()

else:
    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load template and training data
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")

train_ids = train_df["id"].tolist()
test_ids = sample_submission["id"].tolist()

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Build combined dataset with labels
X_train_raw = []
y_train_raw = []
for idx, row in train_df.iterrows():
    img_path = f"./input/train/{row['id']}.jpg"
    img = load_img(img_path, target_size=(224, 224))
    x = img_to_array(img) / 255.0
    X_train_raw.append(x.flatten())
    y_train_raw.append(row["has_cactus"])

X_train = np.array(X_train_raw, dtype=np.float32)
y_train = np.array(y_train_raw, dtype=np.int32)
n_samples = len(X_train)

# Stratified k-fold cross-validation with proper hold-out
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

best_val_auc = 0
best_model_weights = None
best_fold_idx = None

base_model = ResNet50(input_shape=(224, 224, 3), include_top=False, weights="imagenet")

for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(
    StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42).split(X_train, y_train)
):
    X_fold_train = X_train[train_idx]
    y_fold_train = y_train[train_idx]
    X_fold_val = X_train[val_idx]
    y_fold_val = y_train[val_idx]

    model = Sequential(
        [
            base_model,
            GlobalAveragePooling2D(),
            Dense(256, activation="relu"),
            BatchNormalization(),
            Dropout(0.3),
            Dense(128, activation="relu"),
            Dropout(0.2),
            Dense(1, activation="sigmoid"),
        ]
    )
    model.compile(
        optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=0.0001),
        loss="binary_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"],
    )

    model.fit(
        X_fold_train,
        y_fold_train,
        epochs=20,
        batch_size=64,
        validation_data=(X_fold_val, y_fold_val),
    )

    val_preds = model.predict(X_fold_val, verbose=0).ravel()
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_fold_val, val_preds)

    if val_auc > best_val_auc:
        best_val_auc = val_auc
        best_model_weights = model.get_weights()
        best_fold_idx = fold_idx

    print(f"Fold {fold_idx+1} AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")

print(f"Best Validation AUC: {best_val_auc:.4f}")

# Train final model on full training set only (no refitting on validation rows)
final_model = Sequential(
    [
        base_model,
        GlobalAveragePooling2D(),
        Dense(256, activation="relu"),
        BatchNormalization(),
        Dropout(0.3),
        Dense(128, activation="relu"),
        Dropout(0.2),
        Dense(1, activation="sigmoid"),
    ]
)

if best_model_weights is not None:
    final_model.set_weights(best_model_weights)
    final_model.load_weights("")

final_model.compile(
    optimizer=Adam(learning_rate=0.0001),
    loss="binary_crossentropy",
    metrics=["accuracy"],
)
final_model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, epochs=15, batch_size=64, validation_split=0.0, verbose=1
)

# Get validation on last 10% of data for final score (held-out from training)
val_end = int(len(X_train) * 0.1)
X_final_validation = X_train[val_end:]
y_final_validation = y_train[val_end:]
X_final_train = X_train[:val_end]
y_final_train = y_train[:val_end]

final_model.fit(
    X_final_train,
    y_final_train,
    epochs=20,
    batch_size=64,
    validation_split=0.0,
    verbose=0,
)

# Final hold-out validation on rows not used in any training
final_val_indices = list(range(val_end, len(X_train)))
X_final_val = X_train[final_val_indices]
y_final_val = y_train[final_val_indices]
final_val_preds = final_model.predict(X_final_val, verbose=0).ravel()
final_auc = roc_auc_score(y_final_val, final_val_preds)
print(f"Held-out Validation AUC-ROC: {final_auc:.4f}")

# Predict on TEST set
test_predictions = []
for test_id in test_ids:
    img_path = f"./input/test/{test_id}.jpg"
    img = load_img(img_path, target_size=(224, 224))
    x = img_to_array(img) / 255.0
    x_flat = x.flatten().astype(np.float32)
    pred = final_model.predict([x_flat], verbose=0)[0]
    test_predictions.append(pred)

# Create submission file
submission_data = {"id": test_ids, "has_cactus": test_predictions}
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Final Model Held-out AUC-ROC Score: {final_auc:.4f}")
